name: Ordering.swap

source.code:
/--
Swaps less-than and greater-than ordering results.

Examples:
 * `Ordering.lt.swap = Ordering.gt`
 * `Ordering.eq.swap = Ordering.eq`
 * `Ordering.gt.swap = Ordering.lt`
-/
@[inline, expose]
def swap : Ordering → Ordering
  | .lt => .gt
  | .eq => .eq
  | .gt => .lt
